msg: Buenas. Soy buzo Advanced, argentino, voy a estar en Cartagena. En otra escuela me dejan las 2 inmersiones más baratas. ¿Me hacen un precio mejor? Llevo mi propio equipo completo.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Qué bacano que ya seas Advanced; las dos inmersiones en las Islas del Rosario son un plan buenísimo. Para buceo recreativo con equipo propio completo tienes un 5% de descuento, y al reservar online se suma al 10% online. Estos descuentos no se suman entre sí con el de grupo.

Para las 2 inmersiones saliendo desde Cartagena, el precio es **178 USD online** o **197 USD normal** por persona. El descuento por equipo propio se aplica al reservar; no puedo ofrecer un precio distinto por la comparación con otra escuela.

Puedes revisar fechas y reservar aquí: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es

msg: Hey! I got my Open Water certification 3 years ago but haven't dived since. I'm staying in Getsemaní for a week and would love to dive on two different days. What would you recommend and how much is it? Can I pay cash in dollars on the boat?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands! Since it’s been three years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required before recreational dives. It’s booked as the Dive Mini Course; from Cartagena, it’s a one-day activity with a same-day boat return. You could do it on one day, then book two guided dives on another day.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)

I’m leaving the prices below. International guests pay online by card through the booking link; cash in dollars on the boat isn’t accepted. Would you like the booking links for the refresher and the two-dive trip?

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. I'm German by the way. So what's the plan, the refresher on day one and normal dives on day two? Does the refresher day include lunch too?
reply:
Yes, that’s the plan: the refresher on day one, then two guided dives on day two. The refresher includes lunch, and lunch is also included on the Cartagena two-dive trip.

For each day, meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. The boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m. Since you’re German, the prices are in USD: the refresher is 183 USD online (204 USD regular), and the two-dive trip is 178 USD online (197 USD regular). The same prices in COP are 655,000 COP online (727,000 COP regular) and 630,000 COP online (700,000 COP regular), respectively.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Buenas tardes. Soy de Medellín, buzo certificado desde hace años, tengo 70 años y me operaron de la rodilla hace un año. Quiero bucear con mis nietos de 9 y 13 años. ¿Qué podemos hacer los tres y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
Buenas tardes. Para buzos certificados, la salida disponible es de 2 inmersiones en un día:

- **Desde Cartagena:** 630.000 COP online o 700.000 COP precio normal por persona.
- **Si ya están en las Islas del Rosario:** 440.000 COP online o 489.000 COP precio normal por persona.

También hay paquetes de 3 inmersiones (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna) y de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas):

- **Desde Cartagena:** 3 inmersiones, 1.017.000 COP online o 1.130.000 COP normal; 4 inmersiones, 1.154.000 COP online o 1.282.000 COP normal.
- **Ya en las islas:** 3 inmersiones, 665.000 COP online o 739.000 COP normal; 4 inmersiones, 720.000 COP online o 800.000 COP normal.

La edad mínima para buceo certificado es de 10 años, así que tu nieto de 13 puede participar en una salida certificada; para el de 9, la opción es Bubble Makers, para niños de 8 a 10 años, en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas (máximo 2 metros), con instructor PADI dedicado. Los menores deben estar acompañados por un padre o pariente responsable demostrable.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Buenas! Soy argentino, tengo Advanced de SSI con unas 40 inmersiones. Me interesa bucear con nitrox en las Islas del Rosario. Me sirve mi certificación SSI? Ustedes tienen nitrox?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Las Islas del Rosario son un lugar buenísimo para bucear, y sí: tenemos tanques de Nitrox disponibles bajo pedido para buzos certificados en Nitrox. Cuéntanos al reservar que quieres usarlos; cuestan **10 USD por tanque** (**20 USD por dos inmersiones**).

También necesitas:
• Al registrarte recibirás una introducción digital. Debes completar lecturas y pruebas de conocimientos antes de la práctica.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Tu certificación Advanced de SSI acredita experiencia de buceo, pero para la **Especialidad PADI Nitrox** el requisito indicado es tener certificación **PADI Open Water Diver**. No tengo confirmado si tu certificación SSI cumple ese requisito; ¿quieres que te pase con un asesor para revisarlo?

msg: Buenas! Soy argentino, tengo Advanced de SSI con unas 40 inmersiones. Me interesa bucear con nitrox en las Islas del Rosario. Me sirve mi certificación SSI? Ustedes tienen nitrox?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Las Islas del Rosario son un lugar buenísimo para bucear con Nitrox. Sí, tenemos tanques disponibles bajo pedido para buzos certificados en Nitrox; cuestan **10 USD por tanque** (20 USD por dos inmersiones) y debes avisarlo al reservar.

También necesitas:
• Al registrarte recibirás una introducción digital. Debes completar lecturas y pruebas de conocimientos antes de la práctica.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Tu certificación Advanced de SSI acredita experiencia de buceo, pero para la **Especialidad PADI Nitrox** el requisito indicado es tener certificación **PADI Open Water Diver**. No tengo confirmado si tu certificación SSI cumple ese requisito; ¿quieres que te pase con un asesor para que lo revise?

msg: Hola, buceo con certificación CMAS una estrella y tengo 30 inmersiones. ¿Puedo bucear con ustedes?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué chévere que ya tengas 30 inmersiones! Para las salidas recreativas necesitas presentar tu carné de buzo certificado; puedes enviarnos una foto antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente.

Con tu certificación CMAS de una estrella, el nivel y los límites de profundidad aplicables los confirma el equipo según tu certificación. ¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para revisarlo?

msg: Hola, buceo con certificación CMAS una estrella y tengo 30 inmersiones. ¿Puedo bucear con ustedes?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué chévere que ya tengas 30 inmersiones! En principio, puedes participar en salidas recreativas si presentas tu certificación CMAS; puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad. La profundidad se ajusta a los límites de tu certificación.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente.

¿Quieres que te comparta las opciones de buceo y sus precios?

msg: Hello, we're a family from Toronto staying at Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on the islands. Our kids are 9 and 11. What can they do? We parents would snorkel.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

What a lovely family plan! Since you’re staying at San Pedro de Majagua, hotel pick-up is included.

- **Your 9-year-old:** can snorkel (from age 6) or try **Bubble Makers**, a supervised introduction to diving in a pool or very shallow water (maximum 2 m) for ages 8–10. It doesn’t certify.
- **Your 11-year-old:** can snorkel, take the **Dive Mini Course**, or start the **Open Water course**. Certified fun dives are also an option if they already hold an Open Water certification.
- **You parents:** can join the **Snorkeling Tour**. It includes gear, insurance, a PADI professional, and two reef snorkeling sessions. Pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m., with return around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Lunch isn’t included.

Minors must be accompanied by a parent or responsible relative.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Bubble Makers (kids 8-10): 123 USD · 137 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

Would you like the snorkeling booking link, or help connecting with an advisor about Bubble Makers?

msg: Hola, somos 5 amigos de Lima, todos con Open Water, y queremos bucear tres días seguidos saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Qué paquete nos recomiendan y hay descuento por ser grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué buen plan para disfrutar las Islas del Rosario! Para tres días seguidos saliendo desde Cartagena, les recomiendo el **paquete de 7 inmersiones en 3 días**: incluye 6 buceos diurnos y 1 nocturno. Requiere alojarse **2 noches en las islas**; el alojamiento no está incluido.

Deben solicitar el descuento al equipo **antes de pagar**; no se aplica automáticamente y no se devuelve si pagan sin pedirlo.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Paquete de 5 inmersiones (2 días): 392 USD · 436 USD
• Paquete de 7 inmersiones (3 días): 503 USD · 558 USD

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

Pueden revisar el plan aquí: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/3-days-7-dives/10?language=es. ¿Quieren que les ayude a continuar con la reserva?

msg: Hola, somos 5 amigos de Lima, todos con Open Water, y queremos bucear tres días seguidos saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Qué paquete nos recomiendan y hay descuento por ser grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué buen plan para disfrutar las Islas del Rosario! Para bucear **tres días seguidos**, les recomiendo el **paquete de 7 inmersiones**: incluye 6 diurnas y 1 nocturna, con salida desde Cartagena. Requiere alojarse **2 noches en las islas**; el alojamiento no está incluido.

Deben solicitar el descuento al equipo **antes de pagar**; no se aplica automáticamente. Para toda la reserva, al ser un grupo internacional, el pago es en USD.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Paquete de 5 inmersiones (2 días): 392 USD · 436 USD
• Paquete de 7 inmersiones (3 días): 503 USD · 558 USD

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

Pueden elegir la fecha y el número de personas aquí: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/3-days-7-dives/10?language=es. ¿Quieren que les ayude con algún detalle del paquete?

msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible, and what would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Because you’re certified and haven’t dived for three years, the right option is a refresher, booked as the Dive Mini Course. It’s a great way to get comfortable in the water again.

A daytime dive ends around noon, and certified divers need to wait at least 18 hours after their last dive before flying. So a Friday 10:00 a.m. flight would be too soon after diving on Thursday. The refresher is also subject to the 18-hour wait.

However, the booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before, so Thursday’s booking window has already closed. You can use the link to check the next available date:

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Hola, quiero hacer el minicurso saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Tengo que hacer alguna teoría online antes de ir?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué chévere que quieras probar el buceo! No tienes que hacer teoría online: la teoría se hace allí, el mismo día, junto con la práctica en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor. El minicurso no requiere experiencia ni certificación previa y no certifica.

El precio online saliendo desde Cartagena es **183 USD / 655.000 COP**. Puedes reservar aquí: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es

También necesitas:
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 12 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Para el minicurso también se requiere completar un formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. ¿Quieres que te cuente qué llevar?

msg: Buenos días. Mi esposo es buzo Advanced y yo estoy embarazada de cinco meses. Nos alojamos en Cartagena. ¿Puedo acompañarlo en la lancha y hacer snorkel mientras él bucea? ¿Cuánto costaría para los dos?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Sí, puedes hacer snorkel en superficie durante el embarazo, siempre que tengas el visto bueno de tu médico. No se recomienda bucear con botella durante el embarazo. El snorkel se realiza en una zona distinta a la de buceo; según el tamaño del grupo, pueden ir en la misma lancha o separarse por actividad.

El precio online incluye el descuento por reservar en nuestra web. Te dejo los precios a continuación.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Tour de Snorkeling: 126 USD · 140 USD (448.000 COP · 497.000 COP)
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)

Te recomiendo el plan de *2 inmersiones en 1 día* en las Islas del Rosario. (Si prefieres más inmersiones, hay *paquetes* de 3 o más; dímelo.)

msg: Good morning, we are two Belgian divers (both Advanced) staying at a hotel on Isla Grande from the 8th to the 12th. We would like to dive on two different days and do one night dive. We fly home from Cartagena on the 13th at 7 a.m. What do you recommend, and can we pay in euros in cash when we arrive?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good morning! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands. Since you’re already staying there, the **5-dive package over 2 days** fits your plan: four daytime dives and one night dive, with no need to travel from Cartagena. The online booking includes a 10% discount.

You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-5-dives-already-on-island/21?language=en

International guests pay **100% by card through the website in USD**; your bank converts the charge to euros. We don’t quote prices in euros or take payment in cash on arrival. If the online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer payment link while keeping the online discount.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

One important flight-safety detail: you must wait at least **18 hours after diving before flying**. With a 7 a.m. flight on the 13th, your final dive would need to be completed by **1 p.m. on the 12th**. The island-based daytime dives usually finish around 12–1 p.m., so please make sure the timing works for your flight. Would you like to use the booking link for the 5-dive package?

Discounts: 10% discount when booking online directly with us through our website, not through third parties like PADI. This is the standard online discount and is applied automatically when booking on the web. 10% discount for groups of 5 or more people, which stacks with the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). Not applied automatically: the group must contact the team to apply it. It must be requested from the team BEFORE paying: if the group pays without having requested it, the discount is lost (it is not refunded afterwards). Applies to recreational diving, mini-courses, snorkeling and the companion plan; does not apply to PADI courses. The companion (someone who rides the boat without diving or snorkeling) counts as one more person of the group to reach 5 and also gets the group discount. 5% discount if you bring your own COMPLETE gear (regulator, BCD, wetsuit, mask, fins, etc.), only for recreational diving and PADI courses: it does not apply to the mini-course or snorkeling, even with complete gear. It also does not apply if you only bring part of the equipment. Colombian clients and residents pay in Colombian pesos (COP). International clients pay in US dollars (USD). There is no special discount for being Colombian; the price is the same, only the currency changes. Discounts are not cumulative except in special cases authorized by staff or where explicitly stated otherwise (e.g. group + online do stack; own equipment + online also stack). The group discount and the own-equipment discount do NOT stack with each other: each one stacks only with the online discount.
Currency: Colombians (wherever they live) and residents of Colombia pay in COP and everyone else in USD; it is the same price in both currencies. Each plan's COP price is the price for Colombians: a response that gives that price 'for Colombians' is correct. What does not exist is a discount or a reduced rate for Colombians.

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

Question: How long do I have to wait to fly after diving?
Other ways to ask: Can I fly the same day I dive? / What's the minimum time between diving and flying?
Answer: Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing.

Other ways to ask: Can a group with certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers do activities together on the same day? / Is it possible to mix certified divers, mini-course participants, and snorkelers in one tour?
Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine different activities in one tour. Groups can include certified divers, people who want to do the mini-course, and those who only want to snorkel. While certified divers do their first dive or snorkelers do their first activity, mini-course participants do their theory and pool training. On the second dive, if they wish, they can join the mini-course participants for the open water dive. In groups that combine diving and snorkeling, snorkeling is done in a different area from diving. If there are few people, they go together in the same boat; otherwise, they are divided by activity. More info: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced and my last dive was 6 months ago. I'd like to dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Thursday at 11 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

No—because your flight is the same day, the required 18-hour wait after recreational diving won’t be met. From Cartagena, the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m., but the waiting period is counted from your last dive, not from your return.

Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers).

A daytime dive ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., so you’d need to fly no earlier than 7:00 a.m. the next day. Would another dive date work for you?

msg: Hi there. I got my SSI Open Water certification about ten years ago but I've lost my card and I've only done a handful of dives since. Can I still dive with you? I'm from Ireland and I'm travelling alone.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, you can travel alone—our team can assign you a buddy or include you in a guided group. 🌊

You'll also need:
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

Since you’ve only done a handful of dives and it’s been more than two years, a refresher is normally required. Because you’ve lost your SSI card, a team advisor can help look up your certification in SSI’s database. For recreational dives and the refresher, you’ll need to present your certification card; you can show a photo or the card on the day. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help verify your certification and arrange the next step?

msg: 1. Cuakes son sus costos con equipo? 2. ⁠tienen disponibilidad? 3. ⁠tienen algun hospedaje o zona para hospedarme que recomienden centrico a nuestras partidas?
reply:
¡Claro! El equipo está incluido en las salidas de buceo.

Hay disponibilidad para las fechas indicadas; la salida puede suspenderse por condiciones meteorológicas adversas. Puedes hospedarte en nuestra base, en el Hotel San Pedro de Majagua o el Hotel Cocoliso, en Isla Grande. También hay otros hoteles con acceso marítimo: Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras y Pao Pao. El alojamiento se reserva directamente con el hotel y no está incluido en el plan.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo (en los de varios días, el del primer día)
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)

Siempre hay disponibilidad: operamos todos los días, festivos incluidos, salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero; si el mar no está apto, la salida se reprograma.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan y el enlace exactos. 🌊

¡Claro! El equipo está incluido en las salidas de buceo. Para un buzo avanzado, puedes hacer 2 inmersiones en un día; también hay paquetes de 3 inmersiones en un día o 4 en dos días. Te dejo los costos a continuación.

Sí, operamos todos los días salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero; las salidas pueden suspenderse por condiciones meteorológicas adversas. Para Semana Santa, la fecha y el número de personas se eligen en el enlace de reserva.

Nuestra base en las islas está en los hoteles San Pedro de Majagua y Cocoliso, en Isla Grande. También puedes hospedarte en Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras o Pao Pao. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo (en los de varios días, el del primer día)
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan y el enlace exactos. 🌊

msg: Hola. Mi pareja es colombiana y yo soy española, los dos con Open Water y buceando este año. Queremos bucear un día desde Cartagena. ¿Cuánto cuesta y en qué moneda pagamos?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué buen plan! Para buzos certificados, la salida desde Cartagena incluye 2 inmersiones en arrecifes, equipo, lancha y almuerzo.

Como la reserva es mixta, pagan en dólares estadounidenses (USD). El precio online es **178 USD por persona**; el precio normal es **197 USD por persona**. El descuento online se aplica al reservar en nuestra web.

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *178 USD* por persona (reservando online) · 2 personas
✅ Incluye: tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro de buceo obligatorio, transporte en lancha rápida Cartagena-Islas-Cartagena, 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado, equipo de buceo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Salida desde Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *Para más información y hacer tu reserva, haz clic aquí:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es

¿Te ayudo con algo más? Puedo *añadir otra actividad*, resolver dudas o ajustar la reserva. 🤿

msg: hi, I want to book 2 fun dives for me in Cartagena, Advanced diver, dived in June. I'm from Spain. Can I pay cash when I get there instead of online? I don't trust paying by card on websites
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

From Cartagena, the 2-dive trip is a great full-day option, and your Advanced certification is suitable for it. Since you’re visiting from Spain, payment is 100% by card through the website when booking; cash payment on arrival isn’t available. If the online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer link, and the 10% online discount is kept in that case.

The online price is **USD 178 per person** with the 10% discount: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like to book through the link?

msg: ok and if I book and then the weather is bad or I get sick, do I get my money back?

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.

- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.

Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).

The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
